_comment: Configuration file for simulation with covariance matrix. See script for details and defaults
block_comment: If true then each variable is assumed independent
cov_file_comment: Path for obs error covariance file. If null then use default value
cov_time_comment: Start & end time as ISO std string or null for no start or end.
location_file_comment: Path for location file. In this case is target obs for calibration
location_time_comment: Start & end time as ISO std string or null for no start or end.
mslp_vars_comment: Variables to use as MSLP based regions
regions_comment: Std List of regions to process.
special_regions_comment: Special regions for specific variables. If a region is not listed here it will use the default regions.
scales_comment: Scaling factors for specific variables. If a variable is not listed here it will not be scaled. Precip-> mm/day, AOD -> x100, Reff -> microns, MSLP -> hPa, CLDliq -> percent, CTP -> hPa
levels_comment: Levels to use for specific variables. If a variable is not listed here it will use all levels (i.e. no level selection).
override_cov_comment: Override specific covariance values with SI values given here.
